name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump wants a permanent fence around the D.C. park known for White House protests
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to install permanent fencing around Lafayette Park, directly outside the White House. It's long been a popular spot for protesters, who worry barriers will change that. (Image credit: U.S. Commission of Fine Arts).

changes.title: How Nike’s Diversity Efforts Made It a Trump Target
changes.summary: A civil-rights investigation, which grew out of a 26-page memo by a political appointee, provides a road map for the White House’s assault on D.E.I.

changes.title: Karoline Leavitt answers questions on Trump's primetime speech, new Iran strikes
changes.summary: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt spoke to reporters Thursday about President Trump's upcoming primetime speech, the latest strikes against Iran and more.

changes.title: President Trump to deliver prime time address on elections, though details are slim
changes.summary: President Trump is scheduled to deliver a primetime address from the White House focused on election security, though details about the speech are slim.

changes.title: Officials probe whether White House teleprompter operator profited off Trump's words
changes.summary: It's the first known instance of officials investigating suspected insider trading on a prediction market from inside the White House. (Image credit: Justin Sullivan).

changes.title: Trump believes his Kalshi-betting teleprompter operator is a 'disgrace,' Leavitt says
changes.summary: Leavitt added that no other staffers are under investigation and that the White House counsel had no awareness of the alleged bets.

changes.title: Trump's teleprompter operator on unpaid leave over alleged Kalshi bets on Trump speeches
changes.summary: President Donald Trump's teleprompter operator is on unpaid leave after reports that he used his inside knowledge to make bets about the president's speeches on the online prediction market Kalshi, the White House said Thursday.

changes.title: Trump Administration Argues for Fencing Off Park Next to White House
changes.summary: The Commission of Fine Arts is set to consider the administration’s proposal regarding Lafayette Square Park, which has been the site of numerous protests.

changes.title: Trump wants to fence off the park closest to the White House, a popular protest spot
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to install permanent fencing around Lafayette Park, directly outside the White House. It's long been a popular spot for protesters, who worry barriers will change that. (Image credit: U.S. Commission of Fine Arts).

changes.title: U.S. to impose 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports over unfair trade practices, White House says
changes.summary: The United States is imposing 25% tariffs on imports from Brazil after finding a range of what it deemed unfair trade practices by the world's 10th-biggest economy.
